High level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm SOC 2 status and whether a reviewer NDA is required to see the report?

Daniel — thanks for the clear asks and the SIG. I outlined a proposed MAP below and attached a draft SIG response workbook for your review.

Proposed MAP (security/compliance milestones)
1) SIG Qs: Redwood draft responses shared — target 2026-05-22 (we'll flag any items needing evidence).
2) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (in-force). We can provide a read-only link to the report after a short NDA; target to share by 2026-05-25.
3) DPA redline: Redwood legal to provide initial redlines by 2026-05-28; we request Sundown legal to return comments within 5 business days.
4) Data retention options and residency: propose standard profiles — 30/90/365 days and EU-residency deployment option. Final retention/escrow carveouts to be decided by 2026-06-04.
5) Pilot approval: target 2026-06-25 (internal Sundown signoff).

Open items for Redwood legal (cc: Kimberly):
- Confirm mechanism for EU residency deployment (VPC region + data flow documentation).
- Evaluate Sundown ask for 7-year legal hold for specific data classes — we typically offer archival/escrow options; need Kimberly's input on feasibility and cost.

Next steps
- Kimberly: can you take point on DPA redlines and confirm SOC 2 sharing flow (NDA text + secure link)?
- Ben: I'll sync with the solutions team on the EU residency deployment checklist and estimate time to provision.
- Daniel: if these dates look good, we'll drop a MAP doc into the Drive link and convert this thread into an MPA with owners/tags.

Attached: Redwood-SIG-response-draft.xlsx

Thanks — we'll keep the cadence tight to hit late-June pilot approval.

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: SIG + DPA carveouts for pilot

Thanks — looping in our legal notes here. Short answers:

SOC 2
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (security & availability). We can provide the full report via secure link after a mutual NDA; typical turnaround 1–2 business days after countersign.

DPA redlines / carveouts
- Subcontractor notification: we can accept notification within 30 days for material changes; for critical subprocessors we can commit to prior notice where operationally possible.
- EU residency: we offer a regional deployment option (EU region) for accounts with EU residency requirements; there is a provisioning window (2–4 weeks depending on capacity). We will enumerate any additional costs in the MPA.
- Retention & legal hold: default retention profiles we offer are 30 / 90 / 365 days. For longer legal holds (7+ years) we recommend an archival/escrow addendum — this is feasible but requires an SOW and retention escrow terms; estimate 3–4 weeks to finalize mechanisms and cost.

Evidence and timelines
- SIG responses: we'll provide narrative answers and evidence links; items requiring deep-dive (e.g., infra-level config) will be marked and scheduled for a short evidence workshop (30–45m).
- SOC 2 access: we will provide an NDA template.

I'll draft DPA redlines (attachment: Redwood-DPA-template-redlines.docx) and share by 2026-05-28 as proposed. If Sundown wants to accelerate any of the retention carveouts, please flag the specific data classes now so we can scope the SOW.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
